rule: Round-74 rule as written (VALIDATED_UNADJUSTED.json key rule, 0.9.0_WK_ADVI_COTBKF~128): equal = within 0.5 percent; a date is COMPARED when the cache has the row's own-date bar and the fund's previous bar within 5 calendar days; it MATCHES when the custodian's reinvestment price (median of that date's dvr rows, shares >= 0.05) equals the cached price on the own date or the previous bar; validated = compared >= 10 and matching share >= 0.80; refuted = compared >= 10 and matching share <= 0.30; else unreadable (fewer_than_minimum_dates or between_refuted_and_validated). Run unchanged; only the cached column read was switched from Close to Adj Close.
arm_note: The refuting arm CAN say no: 33 of 33 adjusted columns read refuted. In this window every fund's last distribution step in the cache falls after all of its compared dates (0 percent of compared dates after it), so the guaranteed-match region is empty here. For a fund whose distributions are small or recent relative to its compared dates, Adj Close equals Close on the compared dates, the rule cannot tell the adjusted from the unadjusted column, and it would read validated on both; that case does not occur in these 33 and is not tested by this control.

sensitivity.note: NOT THE RESULT. Thresholds were not changed.
sensitivity.reading: Every adjusted column already reads refuted at the written R = 0.30; the smallest R that still refutes all 33 is the largest adjusted share, 0.1667 (1/6 = FCNTX 2 of 12). Unadjusted Close shares of the 33 have a minimum of 0.8966, so at any R up to that value no unadjusted column reads refuted and none leaves validated (S = 0.80 unchanged).

companion_fact_round74: Quoted from VALIDATED_UNADJUSTED.md: 'Over 944 compared dates ... the adjusted close also matches on 19 dates ... Inside the 33 validated funds: 804 dates, 800 matching, 548 both days, adjusted also matching on 6, 794 distinguishing. Every validated fund has at least 10 distinguishing dates.' This control agrees: over the same 804 dates the adjusted column matches on 6 (WGIFX 1, FSKAX 2, FCNTX 2, VEIRX 1) and 800 on Close.
headline: Reproduced 33 validated / 0 refuted / 237 unreadable on Close. The same rule on Adj Close over the 33 reads 33 refuted, 0 unreadable, 0 validated (adjusted matches 6 of 804 dates). The refuting arm is shown able to refute.
not_established: That the rule separates adjusted from unadjusted for a fund whose distributions are small or recent (none of these 33; the control does not cover it); that any of the 237 unreadable series is adjusted or unadjusted; that the cache Adj Close is itself correct; the thresholds were not tested beyond the single sensitivity arithmetic.
